units: ARBITRARY COLMAP scale -- NOT metric (no GPS source)

confidence.definition: Laplace-smoothed agreement ratio (agree+1)/(agree+contradict+2) against triangulated COLMAP track depth over all fused frames

evidence.definition: number of fused frames whose track map constrained this pixel

residual_error.definition: mean |candidate Z - track Z| on agreeing views, scene units (arbitrary)

worst_residual.definition: largest |Z - track Z| over all constraining views (scene units, arbitrary); -1 if no view contradicts

dist_sparse.definition: NN distance to triangulated sparse surface, scene units (arbitrary)
